heading.en: Moroni refuses to exchange prisoners—The Lamanite guards are enticed to become drunk, and the Nephite prisoners are freed—The city of Gid is taken without bloodshed. About 63–62 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua musu Moronae e faafesuiai pagota—Ua faalata leoleo sa Lamanā ia onana, ma ua tatala saoloto pagota sa Nifaē—Ua ave le aai o Kita e aunoa ma se totomasaa. E tusa o le 63–62 T.L.M.

verses.en: Now it came to pass that when Moroni had received this epistle he was more angry, because he knew that Ammoron had a perfect knowledge of his fraud; yea, he knew that Ammoron knew that it was not a just cause that had caused him to wage a war against the people of Nephi.
verses.sm: O lenei sa oo ina ua maua e Moronae lenei tusi sa atili ita o ia, ona sa ia iloa ua iloa lelei lava e Amorona lona lava pepelo; ioe, sa ia iloa ua iloa e Amorona e le o se faamoemoe ua tonu lea na ala ai ona ia sii mai le taua e faasaga i le nuu o Nifae.

verses.en: And he said: Behold, I will not exchange prisoners with Ammoron save he will withdraw his purpose, as I have stated in my epistle; for I will not grant unto him that he shall have any more power than what he hath got.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia fai mai: Faauta, o le a ou le faafesuiai pagota ma Amorona vagana ai ua ia aveese lona faamoemoe, e pei ona ou fai atu ai i la’u tusi; ona o le a ou le tuu atu ia te ia ia toe maua e ia se malosi e sili atu nai lo lea ua ia maua.

verses.en: Behold, I know the place where the Lamanites do guard my people whom they have taken prisoners; and as Ammoron would not grant unto me mine epistle, behold, I will give unto him according to my words; yea, I will seek death among them until they shall sue for peace.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua ou iloa le nofoaga lea ua leoleo ai e sa Lamanā o’u tagata o e ua latou ave faapagota; ma talu ai ona ua le tuu mai ia te a’u e Amorona e tusa ai ma la’u tusi, faauta, o le a ou avatu ia te ia e tusa ai ma a’u upu; ioe, o le a ou saili e faaoo atu le oti i totonu o i latou seia latou aioi mai mo le filemu.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that when Moroni had said these words, he caused that a search should be made among his men, that perhaps he might find a man who was a descendant of Laman among them.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina ua uma ona fai atu e Moronae nei upu, sa ia faatonu atu ia faia se suesuega i totonu o ona tagata, atonu e maua ai e ia se tagata na tupuga mai ia Lamana i totonu o i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they found one, whose name was Laman; and he was one of the servants of the king who was murdered by Amalickiah.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou maua se tasi, o lona igoa o Lamana; ma o ia o se tasi o auauna a le tupu o le na fasioti e Amalekia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Now Moroni caused that Laman and a small number of his men should go forth unto the guards who were over the Nephites.
verses.sm: O lenei sa faatonu e Moronae ia Lamana ma se vaega toaitiiti o ona tagata ia o atu i leoleo o e sa leoleoina tagata sa Nifaē.

verses.en: Now the Nephites were guarded in the city of Gid; therefore Moroni appointed Laman and caused that a small number of men should go with him.
verses.sm: O lenei sa leoleoina tagata sa Nifaē i le aai o Kita; o lea na tofia ai Lamana e Moronae ma faatonu e tatau ona o atu se vaega toaitiiti o tagata faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: And when it was evening Laman went to the guards who were over the Nephites, and behold, they saw him coming and they hailed him; but he saith unto them: Fear not; behold, I am a Lamanite. Behold, we have escaped from the  Nephites, and they sleep; and behold we have taken of their wine and brought with us.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua oo i le afiafi sa alu atu Lamana i leoleo o e na leoleoina tagata sa Nifaē, ma faauta, sa latou vaai mai ua alu atu o ia, ma sa latou valaau mai ia te ia; ae sa ia fai atu ia te i latou: aua tou te fefefe; faauta, o au o se sa Lamanā. Faauta, ua matou sosola mai sa Nifaē, ma o loo momoe i latou; ma faauta ua matou aveina ni a latou uaina ma ua matou aumaia faatasi ma i matou.

verses.en: Now when the Lamanites heard these words they received him with joy; and they said unto him: Give us of your wine, that we may drink; we are glad that ye have thus taken wine with you for we are weary.
verses.sm: O lenei ina ua faalogo mai sa Lamanā i nei upu, sa latou talia o ia ma le olioli; ma sa latou fai mai ia te ia: Tuu mai ia ia i matou sina vaega o a tou uaina, sei o matou inu; ua matou fiafia ua faapea ona outou aumai o le uaina faatasi ma outou ona ua matou vaivai.

verses.en: But Laman said unto them: Let us keep of our wine till we go against the Nephites to battle. But this saying only made them more desirous to drink of the wine;
verses.sm: Peitai sa fai atu Lamana ia te i latou: Tatou taofi a tatou uaina se’i tatou o atu i le taua e faasaga ia sa Nifaē. Ae o nei upu ua fai ma mea ua atili ai ona latou mananao e inu i le uaina;

verses.en: For, said they: We are weary, therefore let us take of the wine, and by and by we shall receive wine for our rations, which will strengthen us to go against the Nephites.
verses.sm: Ona sa latou fai mai: Ua matou vaivai, o lea se’i tuu mai se’i o matou inu sina uaina, ma mo sina taimi ona tatou maua lea o le uaina mo a matou meaai, ia o le a faamalosia ai i matou e o atu e faasaga ia sa Nifaē.

verses.en: And Laman said unto them: You may do according to your desires.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu Lamana ia te i latou: E mafai ona outou faia e tusa ai ma o outou manao.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they did take of the wine freely; and it was pleasant to their taste, therefore they took of it more freely; and it was strong, having been prepared in its strength.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou inu saoloto i le uaina; ma sa lelei i la latou tofo, o lea sa latou inu saoloto atili ai i ai; ma sa malosi le uaina, ona sa saunia i lona malosi atoatoa.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass they did drink and were merry, and by and by they were all drunken.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou inu ma fiafia, ma ua fai fai ua latou onana uma.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And now when Laman and his men saw that they were all drunken, and were in a deep sleep, they returned to Moroni and told him all the things that had happened.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ina ua vaai atu Lamana ma ona tagata ua latou onanā uma, ma ua momoe gagase, sa latou toe foi mai ia Moronae ma ta’u mai ia te ia mea uma na tutupu.

verses.en: And now this was according to the design of Moroni. And Moroni had prepared his men with weapons of war; and he went to the city Gid, while the Lamanites were in a deep sleep and drunken, and cast in weapons of war unto the prisoners, insomuch that they were all armed;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa tusa lenei mea ma le fuafuaga a Moronae. Ma sa saunia e Moronae ona tagata ma auupega o taua; ma sa ia alu atu i le aai o Kita, a’o momoe gase ma onanā sa Lamanā, ma ua lafo atu auupega o taua i totonu i pagota, sa oo ina faaauupegaina uma ai i latou;

verses.en: Yea, even to their women, and all those of their children, as many as were able to use a weapon of war, when Moroni had armed all those prisoners; and all those things were done in a profound silence.
verses.sm: Ioe, e oo lava i o latou fafine, ma i latou uma o a latou fanau, le toatele lea sa mafai ona faaaoga se auupega o taua, ina ua faaauupegaina e Moronae ia pagota uma; ma o na mea uma sa faia ma le matuā leai o se pisa.

verses.en: But had they awakened the Lamanites, behold they were drunken and the Nephites could have slain them.
verses.sm: Ae a na latou fafagua sa Lamanā, faauta ua latou onanā, ma po ua mafai e sa Nifaē ona fasioti i latou.

verses.en: But behold, this was not the desire of Moroni; he did not delight in murder or bloodshed, but he delighted in the saving of his people from destruction; and for this cause he might not bring upon him injustice, he would not fall upon the Lamanites and destroy them in their drunkenness.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, e le o le mea lea sa manao i ai Moronae; sa le fiafia o ia i le fasioti tagata po o le faamasaatoto, ae sa fiafia o ia i le faaolaina o ona tagata mai faafanoga; ma ina ia le aumaia e ia i ona lava luga le faamasinoletonu, o le pogai lea na le manao ai o ia e pa’u’ū ifo i luga o sa Lamanā ma faaumatia i latou a’o latou onanā.

verses.en: But he had obtained his desires; for he had armed those prisoners of the Nephites who were within the wall of the city, and had given them power to gain possession of those parts which were within the walls.
verses.sm: Ae ua ia maua mea sa manao i ai; ona ua ia faaauupegaina na pagota sa Nifaē o e sa i totonu o pa o le aai, ma tuu atu ia te i latou le malosi latou te maua ai vaega na sa i totonu o pa.

verses.en: And then he caused the men who were with him to withdraw a pace from them, and surround the armies of the Lamanites.
verses.sm: Ma ona ia faatonu lea o tagata o e sa faatasi ma ia, ia solomuli mai i tua i se va mai ia te i latou, ma si’o autau a sa Lamanā.

verses.en: Now behold this was done in the nighttime, so that when the Lamanites awoke in the morning they beheld that they were surrounded by the Nephites without, and that their prisoners were armed within.
verses.sm: O lenei faauta sa faia lenei mea i le po, sa oo ina ua ala mai sa Lamanā i le taeao sa latou vaai atu ua siomia i latou e sa Nifaē i fafo, ma ua faaauupegaina o latou pagota i totonu.

verses.en: And thus they saw that the Nephites had power over them; and in these circumstances they found that it was not expedient that they should fight with the Nephites; therefore their chief captains demanded their weapons of war, and they brought them forth and cast them at the feet of the Nephites, pleading for mercy.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona latou vaai atu ua umia e sa Nifaē le pule i luga o i latou; ma i ia tulaga sa oo ina latou iloa ai e le tatau ona latou tau ma sa Nifaē; o lea na faatonu ai e o latou kapeteni sili ia aumaia a latou auupega o taua, ma sa latou aumaia ma lafo atu i vae o sa Nifaē, ma aioi mai ina ia alofagia i latou.

w.en: it was not right that they fight

verses.en: Now behold, this was the desire of Moroni. He took them prisoners of war, and took possession of the city, and caused that all the prisoners should be liberated, who were Nephites; and they did join the army of Moroni, and were a great strength to his army.
verses.sm: O lenei faauta, o le manao lenei sa ia Moronae. Sa ia ave i latou faapagota o le taua, ma pulea le aai, ma faatonu atu ia tatala saoloto pagota uma, o e o lo sa Nifaē; ma sa latou auai i le autau a Moronae, ma sa avea ma malosiaga tele i lana autau.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he did cause the Lamanites, whom he had taken prisoners, that they should commence a labor in strengthening the fortifications round about the city Gid.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ona ia faatonu atu e tatau ona ave sa Lamanā, o e na ia ave faapagotaina, ma amata ona latou faia se galuega o le faamalolosi o olo faataamilo i le aai o Kita.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when he had fortified the city Gid, according to his desires, he caused that his prisoners should be taken to the city Bountiful; and he also guarded that city with an exceedingly strong force.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona ia faamalosia o le aai o Kita, e tusa ma mea na ia manao i ai, sa ia faatonu atu e tatau ona ave ana pagota i le aai o Nuumau; ma sa ia leoleoina foi lena aai i se autau malosi tele.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that they did, notwithstanding all the intrigues of the Lamanites, keep and protect all the prisoners whom they had taken, and also maintain all the ground and the advantage which they had retaken.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou fai, e ui i ala faitogafiti uma a sa Lamanā, taofi ma puipui pagota uma o e na latou aveina, ma tausi foi laueleele ma itu lelei uma na latou toe maua.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Nephites began again to be victorious, and to reclaim their rights and their privileges.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata ona toe manumalo sa Nifaē, ma toe maua mai a latou aia ma o latou faamanuiaga.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Many time did the Lamanites attempt to encircle them about by night, but in these attempts they did lose many prisoners.
verses.sm: E tele taimi sa taumafai ai sa Lamanā e siomia i latou i le po, ae i nei taumafaiga sa aveesea ai faapagota le toatele mai ia i latou.

verses.en: And many times did they attempt to administer of their wine to the Nephites, that they might destroy them with poison or with drunkenness.
verses.sm: Ma e tele taimi sa latou taumafai ai e avatu a latou uaina ia sa Nifaē, ina ia mafai ai ona latou faaumatia o i latou i mea oona po o le onanā.

verses.en: But behold, the Nephites were not slow to remember the Lord their God in this their time of affliction. They could not be taken in their snares; yea, they would not partake of their wine, save they had first given to some of the Lamanite prisoners.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, sa le tuai ona manatua e sa Nifaē le Alii lo latou Atua i lenei lo latou taimi o puapuaga. Sa le mafai ona maua i latou ia latou mailei; ioe, sa latou le fia inuina a latou uaina, vagana ua latou avatu muamua i ni isi o pagota sa Lamanā.

verses.en: And they were thus cautious that no poison should be administered among them; for if their wine would poison a Lamanite it would also poison a Nephite; and thus they did try all their liquors.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona latou faaeteete ina ia leai se mea oona e avatu i totonu o i latou; aua afai e onā le sa Lamanā i la latou uaina e onā ai foi le sa Nifaē; ma sa faapea ona latou tofo i a latou ava malolosi uma.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that it was expedient for Moroni to make preparations to attack the city Morianton; for behold, the Lamanites had, by their labors, fortified the city Morianton until it had become an exceeding stronghold.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina tatau ia Moronae ona faia ni sauniuniga e osofai ai le aai o Morianetona; aua faauta, ua tuiolo faamalosi e sa Lamanā, e ala ia latou galuega, le aai o Morianetona seia oo ina avea ma olo sili ona malosi.

verses.en: And they were continually bringing new forces into that city, and also new supplies of provisions.
verses.sm: Ma sa faaauau ona latou aumai pea o autau fou i totonu o lena aai, ma oloa fou foi o mea manaomia.

verses.en: And thus ended the twenty and ninth year of the reign of the judges over the people of Nephi.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona i’u o le tausaga e luasefulu ma le iva o le nofoaiga a faamasino i luga o le nuu o Nifae.
